items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Raises Revenue Outlook After Strong Q2 And New AI Product Push
items.summary: Fortinet raised its annual revenue forecast after reporting strong Q2 results that exceeded its prior guidance on revenue and profitability. The company highlighted progress in its shift to a subscription led model and deeper use of generative AI across its product suite. Fortinet announced a collaboration with Intel on the Fortinet Security Processor 6 and rolled out new offerings including FortiGate 1200G and FortiSOC. items.title: Intel (INTC) Stock Looks Fully Priced Despite Fair Value Support
items.summary: Intel stock has delivered a very large 1 year gain, yet the current intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and the broader valuation checks now point to something closer to fair rather than clearly cheap or clearly expensive. Over the past 1 year Intel has returned 322.8%, which puts extra focus on whether recent price weakness changes the longer term valuation picture or simply cools a rapid rerating.
